name: Steven Universe Future
description: After saving the universe, Steven is still at it, tying up every loose end. As he runs out of other people's problems to solve, he'll finally have to face his own.

videos.title: Farewell to Steven Universe
videos.overview: Thank you Rebecca Sugar, the Crewniverse, and our amazing fans for the incredible ride. We will always be your family. About Steven Universe: Introducing the Crystal Gems! Garnet, Amethyst, Pearl… and Steven. Steven might not know how to use the magical powers that come out of his bellybutton, but that doesn’t stop him from joining the Gems on their magical adventures!

videos.title: Little Homeschool
videos.overview: One Gem refuses to attend Little Homeschool, a place on Earth where Gems from all over the universe can come learn how to live together peacefully.

videos.title: Guidance
videos.overview: Amethyst has been helping Little Homeschool Gems find jobs on the boardwalk, but Steven isn't sure about her approach.

videos.title: Rose Buds
videos.overview: Steven gets a surprise visit from some old friends, and an even more surprising introduction to some new ones.

videos.title: Volleyball
videos.overview: Steven is determined to help Pink Diamond's original Pearl heal the scar on her face.

videos.title: Bluebird
videos.overview: Steven questions the motives of a mysterious fusion that suddenly shows up at his house.

videos.title: A Very Special Episode
videos.overview: Rainbow Quartz 2.0 promised to hang out with Onion the same day Sunstone scheduled a home safety Geminar! How can Steven be in two places, and two fusions, at once?

videos.title: Snow Day
videos.overview: Steven and the Crystal Gems get a chance to catch up when they’re all snowed in together.

videos.title: Why So Blue?
videos.overview: Steven has heard rumors of a pair of Gems that are still destroying worlds. If he can’t stop them, maybe Lapis can.

videos.title: Little Graduation
videos.overview: Steven and the Gems celebrate Little Homeschool's first graduating class.

videos.title: Prickly Pair
videos.overview: After leaving Little Homeschool, Steven has found a new hobby, plants.

videos.title: In Dreams
videos.overview: Steven and Peridot watch a reboot of their favorite show, Camp Pining Hearts.

videos.title: Bismuth Casual
videos.overview: Pearl invites Bismuth to the roller rink for a lesson on how to forge human relationships.

videos.title: Together Forever
videos.overview: Connie has a really clear vision for her future. Steven wants to make sure he'll be a part of it.

videos.title: Growing Pains
videos.overview: Steven visits a doctor for the first time.

videos.title: Mr. Universe
videos.overview: Greg takes Steven on the road to find the origins of the Universe name.

videos.title: Fragments
videos.overview: Steven heads to the woods to train with a powerful mentor.

videos.title: Homeworld Bound
videos.overview: Steven heads to the Diamonds for advice on how to control his new powers.

videos.title: Everything's Fine
videos.overview: Steven insists that everything is fine.

videos.title: I Am My Monster
videos.overview: Everything is not fine.

videos.title: The Future
videos.overview: Steven is finally ready to move on.
